messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: Fifth protocol. The creature now projects fragments of Mirador: a cut radio, an open door, then the egg under white light.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: These are not your exact memories. It is rebuilding a story with your fear and its own sensations.

choices.label: I cut the projection before it distorts my memories.
I describe every detail to separate image from memory.
I let it feel the fear without making it carry my guilt.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: Eight seconds are missing from your helmet recording. If the creature fills them with your guilt, it may turn that guilt into biological law.

choices.label: I keep the official report until evidence says otherwise.
I admit my memory may be false, even if that accuses me.
I search for the source of the radio blank instead of filling the gap.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: The creature watches you as if it is waiting for a version of the past. What truth can it receive without being trapped inside it?

choices.label: A protected truth: I choose what it can bear.
A complete truth: it has the right to know where it came from.
A verified truth: not one word without corroborated proof.
